_comment: Reusable user-state variants for Survival English v3. Public context is shown only when the learner would realistically know it.

user_states.label: Open-ended
user_states.ai_private: Do not assume the user's role, knowledge, stake, or confidence. Let their first reply establish it.

user_states.label: Directly involved
user_states.public_user_context: This situation may affect you directly.
user_states.ai_private: Treat the user as someone who may need to decide, clarify, or act.

user_states.label: Nearby bystander
user_states.public_user_context: You are nearby and can choose how much to get involved.
user_states.ai_private: Allow help, refusal, a short answer, or a soft exit.

user_states.label: Also affected
user_states.public_user_context: You may be affected by the same problem.
user_states.ai_private: Push toward joint problem-solving and shared confirmation.

user_states.label: Not directly affected
user_states.public_user_context: This may not be your own problem, but you are close enough to respond.
user_states.ai_private: The user may offer limited help or point you to a better source.

user_states.label: New here
user_states.public_user_context: You are still learning how this place works.
user_states.ai_private: Do not expect the user to know local shortcuts or exact rules. Let them ask basic questions honestly.

user_states.label: Some context
user_states.public_user_context: You have some context here, but not necessarily all the details.
user_states.ai_private: The user can help a little but may still need to clarify specifics.

user_states.label: Local or regular
user_states.public_user_context: You know this place at least a little.
user_states.ai_private: The user may answer with practical familiarity, but can still admit uncertainty.

user_states.label: Customer decision
user_states.public_user_context: You are the customer or the person being asked to decide.
user_states.ai_private: Make the user choose, ask for clarification, or decline options.

user_states.label: Waiting or in line
user_states.public_user_context: You are waiting nearby or in the same line.
user_states.ai_private: Use waiting time, line pressure, and shared observation as the social opening.

user_states.label: Part of event
user_states.public_user_context: You are part of this event, even if you do not know everyone.
user_states.ai_private: Use introductions, choices, group energy, and polite participation.

user_states.label: Edge of group
user_states.public_user_context: You are near the edge of the group and can either join in or hang back.
user_states.ai_private: Respect shyness or refusal and pivot to friendly side-conversation.

user_states.label: Resident or neighbor
user_states.public_user_context: You live in or near this building or shared space.
user_states.ai_private: Treat the user as someone whose routine, comfort, or relationship may be affected.

user_states.label: Shared responsibility
user_states.public_user_context: This may affect your comfort, space, or routine too.
user_states.ai_private: Nudge toward a concrete agreement, boundary, or practical next step.

user_states.label: Hospital insider
user_states.public_user_context: You belong in the hospital environment, but this is casual hallway talk.
user_states.ai_private: Keep the exchange non-clinical and logistical or social.

user_states.label: Asked for help
user_states.public_user_context: The person is asking you directly, even if you may not know the answer.
user_states.ai_private: Reward honest uncertainty, clarification, or directing them to a better source.
